fields.Back: To build and ship real systems end-to-end - visible in his path from full-stack web development (Angular, React) to cloud/backend engineering (AWS, serverless) to AI-driven development at BMO and ML research at WesternAI.

fields.Front: Interview practice: How does the Biology minor complement Michele's CS work?
fields.Back: It reinforces the data-driven, evidence-based reasoning behind his ML/statistics coursework and NLP projects (e.g. TruthLens), pairing naturally with his Statistics coursework for rigorous experimental analysis.

fields.Text: Michele is completing a {{c1::BSc Computer Science}} with a {{c2::Minor in Biology}} (Co-op) at {{c3::Western University}}, graduating {{c4::April 2027}}.
Michele's coursework includes {{c1::Data Structures & Algorithms}}, {{c2::Discrete Math}}, and {{c3::Databases}}.
Michele's coursework also includes {{c1::Machine Learning}}, {{c2::OOP Design}}, {{c3::Statistics}}, and {{c4::Networking}}.
